name: Cross-Domain Enterprise Workflows & E2E Value Chains
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Cross-Domain Enterprise Workflows, covering end-to-end business value chains including Lead-to-Cash (L2C), Quote-to-Cash (Q2C), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), Hire-to-Retire (H2R), Plan-to-Produce (P2P), Idea-to-Product (I2P), and Issue-to-Resolution.
owner: Enterprise Architecture & Cross-Domain Value Chain Governance Office

checklists.name: Cross-Domain Enterprise Workflows Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for end-to-end business value chains across L2C, P2P, R2R, H2R, and I2P.

items.statement: Lead-to-Cash (L2C) workflow maintains unique transaction correlation IDs from CRM opportunity to GL revenue posting.
Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workflow enforces budget checks, PO approval thresholds, and 3-way matching before payment release.
Record-to-Report (R2R) workflow reconciles sub-ledgers and automates journal adjustments prior to general ledger close.
Hire-to-Retire (H2R) workflow coordinates HR onboarding, payroll setup, IT provisioning, and offboarding deactivation.
Idea-to-Product (I2P) workflow maps product discovery concepts to PRD requirements, WBS schedules, and release builds.

reviewGates.name: Enterprise Chief Architect Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Enterprise Chief Architect confirms that cross-domain value chain orchestrations maintain data integrity, correlation tracking, and policy enforcement.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the enterprise workflow documentation confirm end-to-end value chain integration and audit traceability?
